id: tooltips:Use maximum continuous RCS thrust for manual control.

id: tooltips:Use fine-grained pulses of RCS thrust for manual control.
key: Use fine-grained pulses of RCS thrust for manual control.

id: tooltips:Strict Attitude Control Profile. High speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
key: Strict Attitude Control Profile. High speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
english: Strict Attitude Control Profile. High speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
chinese: STRICT：姿态调整较快、精度较高，推进剂消耗也较多。

id: tooltips:Balanced Attitude Control Profile. Medium speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
key: Balanced Attitude Control Profile. Medium speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
english: Balanced Attitude Control Profile. Medium speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
chinese: BALNCE：在姿态调整速度、精度与推进剂消耗之间取平衡。

id: tooltips:Relaxed Attitude Control Profile. Low speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
key: Relaxed Attitude Control Profile. Low speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
english: Relaxed Attitude Control Profile. Low speed, accuracy, and propellant burn.
chinese: RELAX：姿态调整较缓和，精度要求与推进剂消耗较低。
ANY：只消除滚转角速度，不强制对齐滚转角。
context: 姿态控制面板 → ROLL → ANY 的提示。说明该滚转模式消除滚转角速度，而不要求把滚转角对齐到指定方向。

id: tooltips:Point the up vector according to the selected target.
key: Point the up vector according to the selected target.
english: Point the up vector according to the selected target.
chinese: NORM：让飞船的上方按所选目标方向对齐。
context: 姿态控制面板的滚转模式说明。Up vector 是飞船自身的上方向，不是界面向上按钮。

id: tooltips:Point the up vector opposite of the selected target.
key: Point the up vector opposite of the selected target.
english: Point the up vector opposite of the selected target.
chinese: INVERT：让飞船的上方与所选目标方向反向对齐。

id: tooltips:Inertial frame of reference fixed to the distant stars.
key: Inertial frame of reference fixed to the distant stars.
english: Inertial frame of reference fixed to the distant stars.
chinese: STAR：固定于远处恒星的惯性参照系。
context: 导航球/姿态参考系 STAR 的说明；Frame 指参考坐标系，不是渲染帧。

id: tooltips:Frame of reference fixed to the surface of the planet.
key: Frame of reference fixed to the surface of the planet.
english: Frame of reference fixed to the surface of the planet.
chinese: SURF：相对于行星表面的参照系。
context: 导航球/姿态参考系 SURF 的说明，参照行星表面。

id: tooltips:Frame of reference fixed to the orbital horizon.
key: Frame of reference fixed to the orbital horizon.
english: Frame of reference fixed to the orbital horizon.
chinese: ORBT：相对于轨道地平线的参照系。

id: tooltips:Frame of reference fixed to the orbital velocity of your vehicle.
key: Frame of reference fixed to the orbital velocity of your vehicle.
english: Frame of reference fixed to the orbital velocity of your vehicle.
chinese: OVEL：相对于飞船轨道速度方向的参照系。
context: 导航球/姿态参考系 OVEL 的说明，参照飞船轨道速度方向。

id: tooltips:Frame of reference fixed to the current target direction.
key: Frame of reference fixed to the current target direction.
english: Frame of reference fixed to the current target direction.
chinese: TGT：相对于当前目标方向的参照系。

id: tooltips:Frame of reference fixed to the next planned burn direction.
key: Frame of reference fixed to the next planned burn direction.
english: Frame of reference fixed to the next planned burn direction.
chinese: BURN：相对于下一机动点火方向的参照系。

id: tooltips:Prograde. Nose points towards orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
key: Prograde. Nose points towards orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
english: Prograde. Nose points towards orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
chinese: 顺行：机头沿轨道速度方向，上方朝轨道外侧。

id: tooltips:Retrograde. Nose points away from orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
key: Retrograde. Nose points away from orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
english: Retrograde. Nose points away from orbital velocity. Up points outside orbit.
chinese: 逆行：机头背向轨道速度，上方朝轨道外侧。

id: tooltips:Orbit Normal. Nose points towards angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
key: Orbit Normal. Nose points towards angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
english: Orbit Normal. Nose points towards angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
chinese: 轨道法向：机头沿轨道角动量方向，上方朝轨道外侧。

id: tooltips:Orbit Anti-Normal. Nose points away from angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
key: Orbit Anti-Normal. Nose points away from angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
english: Orbit Anti-Normal. Nose points away from angular momentum vector. Up points outside orbit.
chinese: 反法向：机头背向轨道角动量方向，上方朝轨道外侧。

id: tooltips:Orbital Horizon Ahead. Nose points towards approaching orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
key: Orbital Horizon Ahead. Nose points towards approaching orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
english: Orbital Horizon Ahead. Nose points towards approaching orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
chinese: 朝前：机头朝向前方轨道地平线，上方背向地表。

id: tooltips:Orbital Horizon Behind. Nose points towards receding orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
key: Orbital Horizon Behind. Nose points towards receding orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
english: Orbital Horizon Behind. Nose points towards receding orbital horizon. Up points away from the surface.
chinese: 朝后：机头朝向后方轨道地平线，上方背向地表。

id: tooltips:Radial Outward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards receding orbital horizon.
key: Radial Outward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards receding orbital horizon.
english: Radial Outward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards receding orbital horizon.
chinese: 径向朝外：机头背向地表，上方朝后方轨道地平线。

id: tooltips:Radial Inward. Nose towards the surface. Up points towards approaching orbital horizon.
key: Radial Inward. Nose towards the surface. Up points towards approaching orbital horizon.
english: Radial Inward. Nose towards the surface. Up points towards approaching orbital horizon.
chinese: 径向朝内：机头朝向地表，上方朝前方轨道地平线。

id: tooltips:Velocity Outward. Nose points towards outside orbit. Up points away from orbital velocity.
key: Velocity Outward. Nose points towards outside orbit. Up points away from orbital velocity.
english: Velocity Outward. Nose points towards outside orbit. Up points away from orbital velocity.
chinese: 速度系朝外：机头朝轨道外侧，上方背向轨道速度。

id: tooltips:Velocity Inward. Nose points towards inside orbit. Up points towards from orbital velocity.
key: Velocity Inward. Nose points towards inside orbit. Up points towards from orbital velocity.
english: Velocity Inward. Nose points towards inside orbit. Up points towards from orbital velocity.
chinese: 速度系朝内：机头朝轨道内侧，上方朝轨道速度方向。

id: tooltips:Surface Forward. Nose points toward surface-relative velocity. Up points away from the surface.
key: Surface Forward. Nose points toward surface-relative velocity. Up points away from the surface.
english: Surface Forward. Nose points toward surface-relative velocity. Up points away from the surface.
chinese: 地表向前：机头沿地表相对速度方向，上方背向地表。

id: tooltips:Surface Backward. Nose points away from surface-relative velocity. Up points towards the surface.
key: Surface Backward. Nose points away from surface-relative velocity. Up points towards the surface.
english: Surface Backward. Nose points away from surface-relative velocity. Up points towards the surface.
chinese: 地表向后：机头背向地表相对速度，上方朝向地表。

id: tooltips:Surface Upward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards surface-relative velocity.
key: Surface Upward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards surface-relative velocity.
english: Surface Upward. Nose points away from the surface. Up points towards surface-relative velocity.
chinese: 地表向上：机头背向地表，上方沿地表相对速度方向。

id: tooltips:Surface Downward. Nose points towards the surface. Up points away from the surface-relative velocity.
key: Surface Downward. Nose points towards the surface. Up points away from the surface-relative velocity.
english: Surface Downward. Nose points towards the surface. Up points away from the surface-relative velocity.
chinese: 地表向下：机头朝地表，上方背向地表相对速度。

id: tooltips:Current relative distance to the target.
key: Current relative distance to the target.
english: Current relative distance to the target.
chinese: 到目标的当前相对距离。

id: tooltips:Current relative velocity to the target.
key: Current relative velocity to the target.
english: Current relative velocity to the target.
chinese: 相对于目标的当前速度。

id: tooltips:Distance at the closest approach to the target.
key: Distance at the closest approach to the target.
english: Distance at the closest approach to the target.
context: 交会面板的距离提示，描述与目标最接近时的相对距离；不是当前相对距离。

id: tooltips:Time until the closest approach to the target.
key: Time until the closest approach to the target.
english: Time until the closest approach to the target.
chinese: 距离最接近目标还有多久。
context: 交会面板的剩余时间提示，描述从当前时刻到最接近所选目标的时间；不是最短距离数值。

id: tooltips:Target Towards. Nose points towards the target. Up points away from the surface.
key: Target Towards. Nose points towards the target. Up points away from the surface.
english: Target Towards. Nose points towards the target. Up points away from the surface.
chinese: 朝向目标：机头对准目标，上方背向地表。

id: tooltips:Target Away. Nose points away from the target. Up points towards the surface.
key: Target Away. Nose points away from the target. Up points towards the surface.
english: Target Away. Nose points away from the target. Up points towards the surface.
chinese: 背向目标：机头背离目标，上方朝向地表。

id: tooltips:Target Alignment. Aligns the vehicle orientation to oppose the target's orientation.
key: Target Alignment. Aligns the vehicle orientation to oppose the target's orientation.
english: Target Alignment. Aligns the vehicle orientation to oppose the target's orientation.
chinese: 对接对齐：使飞船朝向与目标朝向相对。

id: tooltips:Target Anti-Velocity. Nose points opposite the relative velocity to the target. Up points to target's down.
key: Target Anti-Velocity. Nose points opposite the relative velocity to the target. Up points to target's down.
english: Target Anti-Velocity. Nose points opposite the relative velocity to the target. Up points to target's down.
chinese: 目标逆速度：机头背向与目标的相对速度，上方朝目标下方。
时间加速到下一个远地点。
时间加速到下一个近地点。

id: tooltips:Warp to the next SOI change.
key: Warp to the next SOI change.
english: Warp to the next SOI change.
chinese: 时间加速到下一次引力影响范围（SOI）变化。

id: tooltips:Warp to the planned burn time.
key: Warp to the planned burn time.
english: Warp to the planned burn time.
chinese: 时间加速到已规划的机动时刻。
打开或关闭资源分组窗口。
context: 飞行画面序列面板 RES 按钮的提示，开关的是资源分组窗口。

id: tooltips:Thrust-to-weight ratio on the surface of the currently-orbited body.
key: Thrust-to-weight ratio on the surface of the currently-orbited body.
english: Thrust-to-weight ratio on the surface of the currently-orbited body.
chinese: 按当前绕行天体的表面重力计算的推重比（TWR）。

id: tooltips:Delta-V remaining on the planned burn.
key: Delta-V remaining on the planned burn.
english: Delta-V remaining on the planned burn.
chinese: 已规划机动剩余的 Δv。
context: 计划机动面板的 Δv 提示。需要区分计划机动的剩余量和飞船总可用 Δv；该条目的精确数值含义尚待进一步核对。

id: tooltips:How long the planned burn will take.
key: How long the planned burn will take.
english: How long the planned burn will take.

id: tooltips:Time when the burn will begin.
key: Time when the burn will begin.
english: Time when the burn will begin.

id: tooltips:Sets the flight computer to automatically execute the planned burn.
key: Sets the flight computer to automatically execute the planned burn.
english: Sets the flight computer to automatically execute the planned burn.
chinese: 让飞行计算机自动执行已规划的机动。

id: tooltips:Monitor the fullscreen and borderless modes cover, listed with each screen's name and resolution. A windowed window is moved by dragging it.
key: Monitor the fullscreen and borderless modes cover, listed with each screen's name and resolution. A windowed window is moved by dragging it.
english: Monitor the fullscreen and borderless modes cover, listed with each screen's name and resolution. A windowed window is moved by dragging it.
chinese: 全屏或无边框模式使用的显示器。窗口模式可通过拖动窗口移动。

id: tooltips:UI text size. Windows, widgets and tooltips scale with it.
key: UI text size. Windows, widgets and tooltips scale with it.
english: UI text size. Windows, widgets and tooltips scale with it.
chinese: 界面文字大小；窗口、控件与悬停提示会同步缩放。
HUD 仪表的整体缩放比例。

id: tooltips:This should generally be set to only a portion of the number CPU cores your system has.
key: This should generally be set to only a portion of the number CPU cores your system has.
english: This should generally be set to only a portion of the number CPU cores your system has.
chinese: 通常只需分配部分 CPU 核心用于轨道求解。

id: tooltips:Hold rotation rate in the STAR frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
key: Hold rotation rate in the STAR frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the STAR frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 STAR 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

id: tooltips:Hold rotation rate in the SURF frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
key: Hold rotation rate in the SURF frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the SURF frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 SURF 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

id: tooltips:Hold rotation rate in the ORBT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
key: Hold rotation rate in the ORBT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the ORBT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 ORBT 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

id: tooltips:Hold rotation rate in the OVEL frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
key: Hold rotation rate in the OVEL frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the OVEL frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 OVEL 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

id: tooltips:Hold rotation rate in the TGT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
key: Hold rotation rate in the TGT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the TGT frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 TGT 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

key: Hold rotation rate in the BURN frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
english: Hold rotation rate in the BURN frame of reference. NOTE: RCS alone cannot perfectly cancel all rotation.
chinese: 保持相对于 BURN 参照系的转动速率；仅靠 RCS 无法完全消除所有转动。

id: tooltips:Bin: drag a part here to delete it
key: Bin: drag a part here to delete it
english: Bin: drag a part here to delete it
chinese: 删除区：将部件拖到此处即可删除。
相机：自由（点击切换到环绕）。
投影：正交（点击切换到透视）。
投影：透视（点击切换到正交）。

id: tooltips:Expansion relative to the motor's. Raising one nozzle's throttles it back, tilting the cluster's thrust away from it.
key: Expansion relative to the motor's. Raising one nozzle's throttles it back, tilting the cluster's thrust away from it.
english: Expansion relative to the motor's. Raising one nozzle's throttles it back, tilting the cluster's thrust away from it.
chinese: 喷管扩张比以发动机为基准。提高某个喷管的倍率会降低其推力，并使喷管组的合推力偏离该喷管。

id: tooltips:All grain segments are already full.
key: All grain segments are already full.
english: All grain segments are already full.
chinese: 所有药柱段都已装满推进剂。

id: tooltips:Lower values extend burn time at the cost of thrust and specific impulse.
key: Lower values extend burn time at the cost of thrust and specific impulse.
english: Lower values extend burn time at the cost of thrust and specific impulse.
chinese: 数值越低，燃烧时间越长，但推力和比冲（Isp）越低。

id: tooltips:Size the nozzle automatically for the propellant's design chamber pressure.
key: Size the nozzle automatically for the propellant's design chamber pressure.
english: Size the nozzle automatically for the propellant's design chamber pressure.
chinese: 按推进剂的设计燃烧室压强自动设定喷管尺寸。
context: 编辑器 → 固体发动机喷管的自动尺寸设置说明，按推进剂设计燃烧室压强计算。

id: tooltips:The grain's initial burning surface is too small to hold a self-sustaining chamber pressure through this nozzle. Raise the initial thrust.
key: The grain's initial burning surface is too small to hold a self-sustaining chamber pressure through this nozzle. Raise the initial thrust.
english: The grain's initial burning surface is too small to hold a self-sustaining chamber pressure through this nozzle. Raise the initial thrust.
chinese: 药柱的初始燃烧面积太小，无法通过该喷管维持自持燃烧所需的燃烧室压强。请提高初始推力。

id: tooltips:Propellant left over after chamber pressure drops below the minimum. A higher area ratio and/or flatter grain burns deeper.
key: Propellant left over after chamber pressure drops below the minimum. A higher area ratio and/or flatter grain burns deeper.
english: Propellant left over after chamber pressure drops below the minimum. A higher area ratio and/or flatter grain burns deeper.
chinese: 燃烧室压强降至最低值以下后剩余的推进剂。提高喷管面积比和／或采用更扁平的药柱，可使燃烧更深入。

id: tooltips:Highest chamber pressure reached during the burn. This depends strongly on nozzle throat area.
key: Highest chamber pressure reached during the burn. This depends strongly on nozzle throat area.
english: Highest chamber pressure reached during the burn. This depends strongly on nozzle throat area.
chinese: 燃烧过程中达到的最高燃烧室压强。该值会显著受喷管喉部面积影响。

id: tooltips:The speed at which the burning surface eats into the grain at max chamber pressure. This depends strongly on chamber pressure.
key: The speed at which the burning surface eats into the grain at max chamber pressure. This depends strongly on chamber pressure.
english: The speed at which the burning surface eats into the grain at max chamber pressure. This depends strongly on chamber pressure.
chinese: 燃烧面在最高燃烧室压强下向药柱内部推进的速度；该值会显著受燃烧室压强影响。

id: tooltips:Area of the nozzle throat, which is the opening that the combustion gases must pass through.
key: Area of the nozzle throat, which is the opening that the combustion gases must pass through.
english: Area of the nozzle throat, which is the opening that the combustion gases must pass through.
chinese: 喷管喉部的截面积；燃烧气体必须从这里通过。

id: tooltips:Number of canopies packed in this container. They deploy together and share tuning.
key: Number of canopies packed in this container. They deploy together and share tuning.
english: Number of canopies packed in this container. They deploy together and share tuning.
chinese: 此容器内收纳的伞衣数量。它们会同时展开并共用相同设置。
context: 编辑器 → 降落伞容器属性。Canopies 是容器内的伞衣数量；同一组同时展开并共享设置。

id: tooltips:Canopy diameter when fully open. Sets drag area and packed mass, shared by every chute in this part.
key: Canopy diameter when fully open. Sets drag area and packed mass, shared by every chute in this part.
english: Canopy diameter when fully open. Sets drag area and packed mass, shared by every chute in this part.
chinese: 降落伞完全展开时的直径，决定阻力面积和收纳质量；同一部件上的降落伞共用此设置。

id: tooltips:Reefed canopy diameter as a fraction of full.
key: Reefed canopy diameter as a fraction of full.
english: Reefed canopy diameter as a fraction of full.
chinese: 收束状态下的伞衣直径占完全展开直径的比例。
解除收束前，伞衣保持收束状态的时间。
context: 编辑器 → 降落伞属性的收束持续时间，描述伞衣处于受约束的部分展开状态到解除收束之间的时间。

id: tooltips:Length in meters of the riser line.
key: Length in meters of the riser line.
english: Length in meters of the riser line.
context: 编辑器 → 降落伞属性。Riser 是连接伞衣与载荷的吊带/吊索，参数单位为米。

id: tooltips:Altitude gate for an armed chute.
key: Altitude gate for an armed chute.
english: Altitude gate for an armed chute.
chinese: 降落伞已启用时的展开高度阈值。

id: tooltips:Disreef only once predicted peak deceleration would stay under this many g.
key: Disreef only once predicted peak deceleration would stay under this many g.
english: Disreef only once predicted peak deceleration would stay under this many g.
chinese: 只有在预测峰值减速度低于此 G 值时，降落伞才会解除收束并完全展开。

id: tooltips:Adds a cut element to the sequence so cutting these chutes can be staged.
key: Adds a cut element to the sequence so cutting these chutes can be staged.
english: Adds a cut element to the sequence so cutting these chutes can be staged.
chinese: 在分级序列中添加剪伞步骤，以便将切断这些降落伞的动作纳入分级。
context: 编辑器 → 降落伞属性 → 剪伞加入分级的说明。Cut 指切断降落伞，不是减少降落伞数量。

id: tooltips:Which consumer kinds this tank automatically provides propellant for.
key: Which consumer kinds this tank automatically provides propellant for.

chinese: 欢迎体验 KSA 预 Alpha 版。<Separator/>初始场景中，你操控的是名为“Rocket”的飞船。按 <Action:VesselNext /> 或 <Action:VesselPrevious/> 可在几艘现有飞船之间切换。<NewLine/>按 <Action:CameraReferenceFrame/> 可切换相机模式；按住鼠标右键可转动视角。大多数界面面板可以通过点击、拖动来移动、调整大小或隐藏。<NewLine/>KSA 使用常见的飞船操控方式。按 <Action:OpenGameSettings/> 打开设置，在“控制”页查看键位。<NewLine/>按 <Action:ToggleMap/> 可切换飞船视图与地图视图。地图适合规划交会机动和探索太阳系，但操控方式会略有变化。在轨道上的某一点单击鼠标左键，也可在该处规划机动。<NewLine/>在菜单栏中，选择“宇宙”→“将相机移至”，可立即转到其他天体；选择“视图”→“轨道线”，可开关各天体的轨道线。菜单栏中还可以找到其他正在开发的功能。<NewLine/>按 <Action:SimSpeedIncrease/> 提高时间加速倍率，按 <Action:SimSpeedDecrease/> 降低倍率。按 <Action:ToggleGroundTracking/> 打开或关闭地面轨迹，按 <Action:ToggleTransferPlan/> 打开或关闭转移规划。<Separator/>
